name: Atul Bora (AGP politician)
profileSummary: Atul Bora is an Indian politician from Assam affiliated with Asom Gana Parishad. He represented the Golaghat constituency from 1996 to 2001, and has been representing the Bokakhat constituency in the Assam Legislative Assembly since 2016. He was the Minister of Agriculture, Horticulture and Food Processing, Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, Urban Development, Town and Country Planning since 2016 in the Sonowal ministry and the Sarma ministry. He also served as the 2nd president of the Asom Gana Parishad since 2014 and working president of the party from 2011 to 2014.
